versions.changelog:
- Added mandatory use of `aliyun` CLI v3.3.3 or higher, with explicit upgrade/install instructions in prerequisites.
- Introduced new AI-Mode configuration steps for `aliyun` CLI, including user-agent setup specific to this skill.
- Clarified that plugin update via `aliyun plugin update` is required before use.
- Updated all CLI command requirements to use the new AI-Mode user-agent string: `AlibabaCloud-Agent-Skills/alibabacloud-dataworks-data-quality`.
- Prerequisite and CLI install/update sections fully revised for improved setup guidance and accuracy.

Initial beta release – DataWorks Data Quality (Read-Only) skill.

- Enables querying of rule templates, quality monitors (scans), alert rules, scan run records, and logs using aliyun CLI.
- Supports only read-only operations (Get/List APIs); all create, update, or delete actions are blocked.
- Strict parameter confirmation for ProjectId, Id, and region; includes natural language time conversion.
- Secure by design: never prints AK/SK; enforces User-Agent, timeouts, CLI/jq usage, and explicit endpoint/region specification.
- Clear guidance for investigation workflow, decision-friendly Markdown result formatting, and proactive next-step suggestions.
